author: jay5656
quote:
This game is a manifestation of everything that is wrong with the gaming industry. A game that has spent 13 years in the making and over a billion dollars in budget, should not be released in a state like this. 
• 30 FPS cap
• No PC version available at launch
• Launch bugs and glitches
• Overly realistic mechanics instead of being fun
• $100 price tag for the full experience
• Physical cases containing download codes
